final_payload.rationale_summary: After normalizing the core CPI values to consistent period and unit, the change from as of 2019-11-01 to as of 2019-12-01 was 0.472, and the change from as of 2019-12-01 to as of 2020-01-01 was 0.696. Therefore the latter change was higher; the difference between the changes is 0.224.
